name: federal-register
title: Federal Register rules and proposed rules, 2024 and 2025
summary: Research in real Federal Register rules and proposed rules of five agencies: find the documents that meet stated criteria, follow a rulemaking to its final rule, count comment periods and effective dates, and check records against texts.
description: Every task gives the AI the same files: the Federal Register's records of every rule and proposed rule that five federal agencies published in 2024 and 2025, 386 documents, and the published text of 89 of them. The agencies are the Internal Revenue Service, the Agricultural Marketing Service, the Office of Personnel Management, the Social Security Administration and the Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation. Each question states its definitions and asks for exact answers, such as which documents meet the criteria, how long a comment period ran, which proposal led to which final rule, what a correction or a withdrawal refers to, what a rule's text says about a budget or a penalty, and where the records and the texts disagree. Every field of the answer is checked, and a task passes only when all of them are right.

families.name: Finding documents
families.what: The documents that meet stated criteria on agency, CFR part, title and action, including withdrawals traced through their Federal Register citations.

families.name: Comment periods
families.what: Comment periods counted from the dates, deadlines that precede publication, and extensions and reopenings matched to the proposal they prolong.

families.name: Effective dates
families.what: From publication to effect, rules in effect before they were published, and delays matched to the rules they delay.

families.name: Rulemaking histories
families.what: A rulemaking followed from proposal to final rule by regulation identifier number, docket and citation, with its intervals and figures.

families.name: Corrections
families.what: Correction documents told apart and matched to the documents they correct, from the records and from the texts.

families.name: Counts and shares
families.what: Documents and pages by month, day, agency and length, and the share marked significant, with each definition stated.

families.name: CFR coverage
families.what: Which titles and parts of the Code of Federal Regulations the documents concern, and which parts only rules or only proposals touch.

families.name: Facts from the texts
families.what: Budgets, assessment rates, penalty amounts, employee counts and tables of spreads read from the rules' own texts.

families.name: Record checks
families.what: The records checked against themselves and against the texts: pages, citations, CFR parts and filing dates, without false alarms.
